messages.subject: R QCA session aborted after superSubset()
parts:
Hi together,

everytime I'm trying to run the suberSubset() on the MreInput file (see below) the calculation takes a lot of time until R is running into the following error: R session aborted. R encoutered a fatal error. The session was terminated.

I am loading the file into R > load into the QCA enviroment > convert it into a data frame > and apply: 
superSubset(MreInput, outcome = "Outcome", incl.cut = 0.9, ron.cut = 0.6) 
or 
superSubset(MreInput, outcome = "Outcome")
> the result is always the same

I hope anybody could help me with that problem, thanks in advance!

Joël

messages.subject: Re: R QCA session aborted after superSubset()
parts:
QCA is usually known as a "medium-N" analysis, and that is also related to the number of conditions because there has to be at least a certain number of cases for any given number of conditions (I really hope there are not just 4 cases for 19 conditions).

Having so many potential causes for your outcome will necessarily create millions of potential inter-relations between all of those causes.
And having millions of explanations for a phenomenon is essentially similar to having no explanation at all. Saying "everything goes" is in no way better than saying "I have no explanation".

I counted no less than 19 conditions, that is a whole lot.
Any particular reason why you would need so many conditions?

Best,
Adrian
